records.issue_text: sm_comp_patcher is entered in setUp without leak safety; if setUp fails after __enter__, tearDown never runs and StatusChangeMessage.__eq__ stays monkey-patched globally
records.rationale: In `BaseDetectorHandlerTest.setUp`, the code manually enters a patcher (`self.sm_comp_patcher = mock.patch.object(StatusChangeMessage, "__eq__", status_change_comparator)` then `self.sm_comp_patcher.__enter__()`). Cleanup is only done in `tearDown` via `__exit__`. If `setUp` raises after `__enter__` (e.g., during the nested `GroupType`/handler class setup), `tearDown` will not execute and `StatusChangeMessage.__eq__` remains globally patched for the rest of the test run, causing cross-test contamination/flakiness.
